card.name: Mid-sentence words in explanatory health text
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on varied ordinary words in the middle of plain explanatory sentences about health or science, just before the sentence continues with a verb or noun.

modes.label: Verb or noun mid-clause
modes.description: A common word such as start, place, have or dose sits inside a factual statement.
modes.example: At least half of all cases<< start>> before age 25.

card.plain: It fires on scattered ordinary words inside explanatory sentences, with no pattern a clinician could rely on.
